text:
sophia (FinLedger PM): Hey team, request incoming — customer wants us to onboard Vela-30B (hf/fin/vela-30b) into Dedicated for an investor demo next Tue. Needs chat+embeddings. They asked for a 4-bit quantized variant to hit cost targets but mentioned prior quality drops. Can we triage and list blockers + ETA?

maya (ML Eng): Thanks — can you paste the HF repo link and a couple representative prompts + expected behavior? Also confirm target latency/throughput and whether they can accept a fallback model for high-cost paths. :eyes:

sophia (FinLedger PM): Repo: https://huggingface.co/fin/vela-30b. Example prompt: "Summarize transaction history focusing on anomalous transfers." Expected: concise 3-4 bullet summary, preserve numeric detail. Target: p50 < 200ms on Dedicated single-request path, baseline throughput ~40 rps. Fallback allowed but prefer same model family.

kevin (Infra Eng): Noted. For Dedicated, we should aim for p50 ~150ms with 8k context if possible. We'll need quantized weights and a candidate CPU fallback. Who will run initial quantization/quality checks?

maya (ML Eng): I'll own quantization experiments + accuracy regressions. Plan: run PTQ (per-channel symmetric) and a GPTQ pass if PTQ degrades too much. Steps: 1) smoke run unquantized in our staging runtime, 2) PTQ -> evaluate, 3) GPTQ if needed -> evaluate, 4) perf sweep on Dedicated config.

oliver (Solutions Eng): FYI: customer uses embeddings heavily. If quant changes embedding space, downstream metrics break. Need embedding drift checks (cosine similarity on a holdout set) and a small reranking eval.

quant-bot: Auto-check results for hf/fin/vela-30b pulled. Warnings: uses RMSNorm + fused ops not currently in our fastest kernel path. Estimated size (fp16): 60GB. Potential issues with fused kernels during GPTQ.

maya (ML Eng): Good catch — RMSNorm means we might need a kernel shim or fallback to slower path for exact match. I'll add a task: patch runtime or accept 1.2x latency penalty for kernels.

maya (ML Eng): Quick checklist (I'll update as we go):
- [ ] HF repo + model card (sophia provided)
- [ ] Representative prompts + eval labels (need 200 samples from customer)
- [ ] Smoke run unquantized on staging (owner: maya)
- [ ] PTQ recipe (owner: maya)
- [ ] GPTQ attempt if PTQ fails (owner: maya)
- [ ] Embedding drift evaluation (cosine sim distribution) (owner: oliver)
- [ ] Perf sweep on Dedicated config (batch sizes, kv cache warm-up) (owner: kevin)
- [ ] Rollout plan (canary % and automatic fallback) (owner: kevin/oliver)
- [ ] Customer sign-off on quality delta thresholds (owner: sophia)

kevin (Infra Eng): For perf sweep I'll need target hardware: are we planning A100-80GB or H100? Which quant kernels will we run? Also what's acceptable memory footprint with 4-bit?

maya (ML Eng): Start with H100 and A100 configs. For 4-bit PTQ expect ~15GB-18GB active on H100 with kv cache for 8k; GPTQ could be slightly smaller but kernel implications differ. We'll log memory peaks.

oliver (Solutions Eng): Embedding drift acceptance: propose mean cosine >= 0.98 and 5th percentile >= 0.90 vs fp16 baseline. If below, we need a hybrid approach (fp16 embeddings + quantized LM) or per-call dequant for embeddings. Thoughts?

maya (ML Eng): Agree on thresholds as a starting point. We'll produce a small report: accuracy (ROUGE/EM/embedding cosines), sample diffs, and latency/cost table.

quant-bot: Scheduled tasks created: task-8342 (smoke run), task-8343 (ptq pipeline), task-8344 (embedding drift eval). Links: https://redwood/tasks/8342

kevin (Infra Eng): Timeline proposal: smoke run + initial PTQ accuracy by EOD Thu, GPTQ + perf sweep Fri-Mon, canary Dedicated rollout Tue morning. Might be tight; need 200 labeled evals from customer by Wed morning to hit that.

sophia (FinLedger PM): I'll push to get eval samples today, target Wed AM. Also they said demo can accept a non-canonical fallback if we document differences.

maya (ML Eng): Commands I'll run for smoke eval (staging):
```
# pull model
run-smoke --model hf/fin/vela-30b --mode fp16 --ctx 2048 --out /tmp/vela-smoke.json
# eval
python tools/eval_metrics.py --pred /tmp/vela-smoke.json --gold data/vela-holdout.json --out ~/vela-smoke-report.json
```

oliver (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare embedding test harness and a tiny synthetic rerank suite. Will share results as CSV.

maya (ML Eng): Blockers right now: customer eval samples, confirmation of hardware, and permission to run GPTQ (requires extra infra time). Once we have samples I'll start PTQ.

kevin (Infra Eng): I've reserved a H100 pod Tue-Fri for testing. Marking dependent tasks in infra.

sophia (FinLedger PM): Thanks all — I'll get samples and confirm fallback tolerance. Will update in this thread. :thumbsup:

maya (ML Eng): Great. I'll update checklist and post initial smoke numbers here when done. :party_parrot:

quant-bot: Reaction: :white_check_mark: to task creation.
